name: Wayfarer Tongue L9: The Protected Word

system.source: Bad Eden Bulwark + Shadow Courier v1.0 (RFI-native rules)

description.value:
The word inside you cannot be opened by force.

A Message you are carrying cannot be:

  • Stolen from you by mundane or magical means

  • Compelled out of you by manifestation, ritual, condition, or torture

  • Read by divination, scrying, telepathic, or empathic effect

This protection holds until you deliver the Message or willingly reveal it. If you are killed before delivery, the Message becomes inert rather than extractable — the contents dissolve from any vessel that might have carried them.

Feedback bite. If a creature attempts to compel speech from you about a Protected Message and fails its caster check (or equivalent), it takes 1d10x10 psychic damage as the refusal recoils through its working.

system.requirements: Route of the Wayfarer Tongue, Shadow Courier Initiation 9
